response.sql: WITH city_address_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), stats AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses, AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city FROM city_address_counts) SELECT cac.city_id, cac.address_count, cac.address_count / s.avg_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average, cac.address_count / s.total_addresses AS share_of_all FROM city_address_counts cac CROSS JOIN stats s ORDER BY share_of_all DESC LIMIT 10
